rule: All four required fields need explicit saved observations; source-file completion or a verified status alone is insufficient. A stored pin is matched only to independently observed coordinates within 12m rounding allowance. Corporate and property-management category alone are not brokerage proof. Any preserved unverified extra phone keeps the record out of fully verified.
privacyNote: Evidence payloads remain in the authorized workspace; this GitHub-safe checkpoint stores field decisions, source filenames, and hashes without duplicating phone/address payloads.
